title: Jollof Rice
summary: A rich and spicy one-pot rice dish cooked in tomato stew, often served with fried plantain and grilled chicken.

title: Banku and Tilapia
summary: A Ghanaian favorite made from fermented corn and cassava dough, served with grilled tilapia and spicy pepper sauce.

title: Waakye
summary: A flavorful rice and beans dish cooked with millet leaves, enjoyed with stew, spaghetti, and gari.

title: Fufu and Light Soup
summary: Pounded cassava and plantain served with spicy light soup and meat or fish — a traditional Sunday delight.

title: Kelewele
summary: Spicy fried plantain seasoned with ginger, pepper, and cloves — a perfect street snack or side dish.
